lesson: files.read returns the whole file as a single text string under the key text. No registered tool parses JSON, so a field nested inside a JSON file cannot be addressed by a reference path: /text/project/topic does not exist and fails INPUT_INVALID with reference path does not exist. The only addressable keys are the tool declared outputKeys. If a request needs a field from inside a JSON document, say that it cannot be extracted with the available tools and offer to pass the whole text instead.
